issues.title: Coupon not applying at checkout
issues.problem_statement: The customer's coupon code was not applying at checkout for the Advanced Course and showed "Invalid coupon".

issues.title: Wrong company name on invoice
issues.problem_statement: The company name in the GST part of the customer's invoice is shown incorrectly.

issues.title: Extend coupon expiry date
issues.problem_statement: The customer wants to extend the coupon's expiry date.

items.description: Support explained that the coupon was assigned only to the Starter Course and not to the Advanced Course, so the Advanced Course had to be assigned to it.
evidence: Coupon dashboard mein ye coupon sirf Starter Course ke liye assign hai, Advanced Course ke liye nahi.

items.description: Customer edited the coupon, selected the Advanced Course in the Products section and saved it, following support's guidance; the customer then tested and confirmed the discount shows at checkout.
evidence: Ho gaya. Ab test karta hoon... haan, ab checkout pe discount dikh raha hai.

items.description: Customer reported that the company name in the GST part of the invoice is wrong.
evidence: invoice mein meri company ka naam galat aa raha hai, GST wale part mein.

items.description: Support will check with the billing team about the invoice company name and tell the customer.
evidence: Uske liye main billing team se check karke aapko kal tak bata dunga.

items.description: Support explained that the customer can extend the coupon expiry date themselves in the coupon settings, where the date option is available.
evidence: Expiry aap khud coupon settings mein badha sakte ho, wahin date ka option milega.

items.description: Customer will extend the coupon expiry date in the coupon settings.

skip_recommendation.explanation: Complete support call with clear outcomes.
